reason: The row's trigger — 'Nvidia-backed; 2026 IPO plans reported' — rests on CNBC's 4 Sep 2025 interview in which CEO Sanjay Poonen said Cohesity could list in 2026 once it has a full year of post-Veritas results. That is 267 days before the row, far outside the 90-day window. A live re-check as of 29 May 2026 found no fresh capital or identity inflection inside the window: no public S-1, no reported confidential filing since the shelved December 2021 one, no new primary round (the last was the Series H at ~$7B in December 2024) and no company-sponsored tender reported in 2026 (secondary-market marks in June 2026 sat near $4.7B per Forge, below the Series H price). What Cohesity did announce in the window is partnership news — a 2026 Google Cloud Partner of the Year award (21 Apr), an expanded HPE alliance (14 May) and a CISA information-sharing partnership (21 May) — none of which is a sponsorship trigger under the standard. The earlier proof hero (N° 001, 29 May 2026, 82/100 → Cadillac F1 Team) was built on the same September 2025 report and should be read as stale for the same reason. Cohesity remains a strong future prospect: re-run the row the day an S-1 (public or reported confidential filing) lands. Carol Carpenter (CMO since Feb 2025) remains the right owner; the Cadillac lane (no data-protection or cybersecurity partner on the inaugural roster) was still open as of this check.
